A post office called Jamestown was established in 1849, and remained in operation until 1914.

notes_for_editor: The name 'jamestown' is the list compiler's own label: cite 1 says names for towers 73 and above are the compiler's creation, and this entry is number 389. No USGS, agency or register name was found. The cached USGS GNIS names file has a Jamestown populated place at 32.2723724, -84.8390926 in Chattahoochee County (the former town) and no tower by that name. TopoZone's Chattahoochee County tower list (https://www.topozone.com/georgia/chattahoochee-ga/tower/) shows a Chattahoochee Lookout Tower near Glen Alta and no Jamestown tower. The list gives no unit for elevation; 332 is read as feet, which matches the record's 101.2 m. Build date, builder, staffing, fires, status and access are unknown: two searches and about five page reads found nothing on them.
